title: Northern Ireland local-government boundary orders, 1921-1972
description: Orders, Acts and notices that altered local-government areas in Northern Ireland between 1921 and 1972 (urban and rural districts, boroughs, county boroughs, towns, wards, district and county electoral divisions, county boundaries), each with its dates, reference, areas, a one-line summary, where it is printed and the map editions that cite it. Facts only; the Belfast Gazette and legislation.gov.uk texts are Crown copyright under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

sources.title: The Belfast Gazette, issues 1921-1972
sources.note: Every issue was read through its text layer; 131 notices were also read on the printed page.

sources.title: legislation.gov.uk: Northern Ireland Statutory Rules and Orders and Acts, 1921-1972
sources.note: Only instruments still on the site; most local boundary orders were never printed in the annual volumes and are known only from the Gazette.

fields.made: Date the order was made, sealed or confirmed, or the Act received Royal Assent.
fields.inForce: Date the change took effect for all purposes, where printed.
fields.verification: printed-page-read: read on the printed Gazette page; cited-on-map: already cited by a map edition after checking; text-layer-extracted: found in the Gazette text layer only, check the page before relying on it; listed-on-legislation-gov-uk: the instrument page on legislation.gov.uk.
fields.layers: Map editions (data/database/maps.json ids) that cite the order.
fields.editionsAtDate: Northern Ireland editions dated on the order's in-force date that do not cite it yet.
fields.lineDescription: Whether the printed text (the order's page and the two after it) describes the line: line-in-words, townland-schedule, map-reference-only or no. Read from the text layer; neighbouring notices on the same pages can add signals.

notYetDrawn.item: Larne UD extended into Larne RD (Larne Urban District Council Act (NI) 1930); its wards and the Carncastle and Kilwaughter DEDs altered
notYetDrawn.why: The Gazette prints only the 1929 bill notice (plans deposited with the Clerk of the Peace) and the Royal Assent of 25 Nov 1930; the local Act and its schedule are not printed or online. Needs the Act or the deposited plans; the 1946 ward order fixes some points on the 1930-48 line.

notYetDrawn.item: Omagh UD's three urban DEDs made coterminous with the wards of 25 Jun 1935
notYetDrawn.why: The ward order describes the three wards street by street.

notYetDrawn.item: Londonderry County Borough's five wards replaced by three (North, South, Waterside)
notYetDrawn.why: The First Schedule describes the three wards in words.

notYetDrawn.item: Newtownards borough's wards reduced from five to four (27 Jun 1938)
notYetDrawn.why: No order found in the Belfast Gazette 1937-39 or on legislation.gov.uk; source still needed.

notYetDrawn.item: Enniskillen UD extended (first stage), with its wards and Enniskillen Rural DED
notYetDrawn.why: The extension order is printed only as a confirmation notice, but the ward order of 19 Oct 1945 and the Enniskillen Rural DED order of 20 Oct 1945 describe the lines in words, including the new town boundary.

notYetDrawn.item: Holywood UD extended; Holywood Rural DED reduced
notYetDrawn.why: The Schedule describes the added area along fences and roads (also on an annexed map).

notYetDrawn.item: Carrickfergus UD extended; four Larne RD DEDs re-constituted; six wards
notYetDrawn.why: The extension order describes the boundary by metes and bounds along fences; the ward order describes the six wards; the Larne RD DEDs follow townlands.

notYetDrawn.item: Larne borough's ward boundaries altered (order of 22 May 1946)
notYetDrawn.why: The ward order describes the internal ward lines and fixes points on the outer boundary (boundary posts on the Ballymena and Cairncastle roads, the Inver River), but the outer line itself is the unprinted 1930 Act line.

notYetDrawn.item: Portadown UD extended; Lurgan RD DEDs re-constituted
notYetDrawn.why: The order describes the added area in words (also on an annexed map); the Lurgan RD DED order follows townlands.

notYetDrawn.item: Enniskillen UD extended (second stage); Enniskillen Rural DED; wards
notYetDrawn.why: The 1946 order describes the line in words; the ward order of 19 Nov 1947 re-describes the three wards.

notYetDrawn.item: Cookstown UD extended; Grange and Lissan Lower DEDs
notYetDrawn.why: The confirmed order describes the boundary in words; the DED order moves townlands.

notYetDrawn.item: Armagh UD divided into five wards (order of 29 Jul 1946)
notYetDrawn.why: The ward order describes the five wards street by street.

notYetDrawn.item: Larne borough extended
notYetDrawn.why: A Provisional Order Confirmation Act (assent 25 Nov 1947); the Gazette prints only the assent. Needs the Act schedule or plan.

notYetDrawn.item: Keady UD extended; Crossmore DED reduced
notYetDrawn.why: The order adds one valuation lot shown on an annexed map; the text names it but does not walk the line. The Valuation map or the deposited plan settles it.

notYetDrawn.item: Dungannon's three wards re-bounded (order of 20 Nov 1948); any townland moves among Bush, Granville and Newmills
notYetDrawn.why: The ward order describes the wards in words; the Dungannon RD DED order lists townlands (Tyrone townland lines are needed).

notYetDrawn.item: Newtownards borough extended
notYetDrawn.why: A Provisional Order Confirmation Act; the Gazette prints only the assent.

notYetDrawn.why: The order describes the extended boundary in words; the DED and ward orders follow it.

notYetDrawn.item: Larne borough extended

notYetDrawn.item: Belfast County Borough and County Antrim boundary altered (Ballydownfine): Boundary Survey (Ireland) Act 1854 Orders in Council (S.R.&O. 1962 Nos 38 and 39)
notYetDrawn.why: The Gazette notice (Ministry of Finance, 5 Mar 1962) says the two Orders, with the Boundary Surveyor's reports and Ordnance plans, were lodged with the Clerk of the Crown and Peace; the Orders are not on legislation.gov.uk. Needs the S.R.&O. text or the lodged plans.

notYetDrawn.item: Omagh UD extended into Omagh RD (Omagh Urban District (Alteration) Order 1963); Omagh RD DEDs altered
notYetDrawn.why: Found only as the 1963 order (in force 1 Apr 1964): no separate 1962 Omagh UD/RD order is in the Gazette (1961-63 searched). The order walks the line in feet along hedges, walls and roads, and the RD order re-forms the DEDs.
